articles.title: Woman vanishes after changing sides to support Indonesia's government
articles.summary: Yasinta Moiwend has disappeared without a trace from West Papua. Her family reports she cannot be reached by phone and her current whereabouts are unknown. She was last seen near her home in Ilwayab district. This incident has raised concerns, given the region's context, emphasizing the vulnerability of individuals there.

articles.title: Army gears up to order 300 more K9 Vajra self-propelled artillery guns under Rs 23k crore modernisation programme
articles.summary: The K9 Vajra-T, a customized Indian variant of South Korea's K9 Thunder, holds the distinction of being the world's most exported self-propelled howitzer. Larsen & Toubro manufactured the K9 Vajra-T for the Indian Army under the 'Make-in-India' initiative. This highlights indigenous defence production capabilities and strategic international collaboration for advanced artillery systems.
